meta_data.base_class: Analyze the string to find and save the frequency of <specific characters> - referring to the basic components in a text string that can be counted and statistically analyzed.

tool_template.name: symbol_frequency_of_<class>
tool_template.description: Analyzes a string to find the frequency of <class>.

input_string.description: A string containing <class> to be analyzed.

file_path.description: The file path where the result should be saved.

sort_order.description: Defines the sorting order for the frequency results. Options include 'Descending', 'Ascending', and 'Alphabetical'.

top_n.description: Limits the output to the top N most frequent <class> symbols.

min_frequency_threshold.description: Sets a lower bound; only <class> symbols with frequency equal to or higher than this threshold will be included in the result.

include_summary_stats.description: Determines whether to include summary statistics (e.g., mean frequency, symbol diversity index) in the output.
